title: Baselines under Sage's kernel pacing: Sage and expliCCit as agent_pure
description: Sage's released policy (exp-sage-model-24) and expliCCit's released policy as deployed (third_party/expliccit-models) run as agent_pure, the controller Sage's kernel (4.19.112-0062 "pure" with DeepCC pacing, read from its binary) is: the window each action sets, and pacing at every delivery at max(cwnd, packets_out) * MTU / srtt. Same families, links, conditions and campaign seed as exp-baselines-192, where both ran as agent (pacing once a step at cwnd * MSS / srtt); pairing is by link and condition. experiments/baselines_report.py reports both under the names expliccit-pure and sage-pure.
prepare: SAGE="$IN/sage/sage/sage.onnx"; echo "fc0d6f1da45e4948ee3d96784642793954ed5e52adc1eddd0c9883d5d8fe2f9e  $SAGE" | sha256sum -c; uv run expliccit train import-expliccit third_party/expliccit-models "$OUT/expliccit" --as-deployed; P=(--policy "expliccit-pure=$OUT/expliccit/policy.onnx@pure" --policy "sage-pure=$SAGE@pure"); S=; for fd in training:30 new:30 deep-long:30 cubic-first:60 rise:30 cellular:30 case-studies:80; do f=${fd%:*} d=${fd#*:}; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-$f-$d" --split test --family "$f" --duration-ms "${d}000" --seed 31 --stock "$S" "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$f-$d/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-$f-$d"; done; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split test --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --n 2 4 --stock "$S" "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; cp "$OUT/spec-training-30/aliases.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables flow_seconds; done
